bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE MONDAY NIGHT... Combined seas 14 to 16 feet, rising to 18 to 20 ft this evening. Bar conditions severe. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 800 PM Sunday, 915 AM Monday, and 900 PM Monday.
